Subject: Workspace gatekeeper & invite handoff - AstraHead onboarding

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. To make sure the initial workspace and admin access are ready for your engineering & security teams, I sketched a short handoff plan (attached) that covers:

- Workspace & project naming convention
- API key seeding and ephemeral key policy for sandbox vs prod
- Admin and developer role mapping (surface-level RBAC)
- SSO / SCIM notes (we can pivot if you want SAML instead)
- Expected invites cadence and who signs each step

Action items I want to confirm from you:
1) Final list of people who need admin access in the first 7 days (email addresses)
2) Whether you prefer KMS-managed keys or Redwood-managed keys for initial PoC
3) Any procurement constraints on DocuSign or billing contact

I'm looping Monica (CS) to run the implementation plan. Monica — once Alex confirms, can you draft the mutual action plan and a short 2-week sprint timeline? I recommend we seed 2 API keys (sandbox/prod) and create the following projects: astra-prod, astra-poc, astra-dev.

Attachments: RH_implementation-MAP_v1.pdf (draft), invite-role-matrix.xlsx

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Workspace gatekeeper & invite handoff - AstraHead onboarding

Lauren — thanks, this looks good. Quick notes from our side:

- Admin list: I'll confirm a final list tomorrow but early draft: alex@, priya@, and engineering leads (eng-lead1@astrahead.com; eng-lead2@astrahead.com).
- KMS: Security wants us to use our AWS KMS for prod keys. For the PoC, Redwood-managed ephemeral keys are fine.
- SSO: We use Okta (SCIM + SAML). We need the SCIM endpoint and service account to be ready before invites so we can sync groups instead of manual invites.
- SOC2 evidence: our security team will request SOC 2 Type II; if you can point them to the relevant SOC materials / audit contact that speeds things up.

Also: procurement would like pricing and an order form before they sign anything — Priya, can procurement confirm timeline?

—Alex

Hi all — looping Ben (onboarding lead) and Karthik (solutions) to coordinate the setup. Draft mutual action plan below — please reply with any timing constraints.

Mutual Action Plan (draft)
Week 0 (pre-kickoff) — deliverables (Redwood):
- Provide SCIM service account details and SCIM sync doc (if AstraHead wants groups)
- Provide SOC 2 summary + contact link (RH security)
- Seed sandbox API key and create projects: astra-poc, astra-dev

Week 1 (kickoff & PoC) — deliverables (joint):
- Kickoff call: walkthrough of keying, prefix caching, and role matrix
- AstraHead to confirm admin list and set up Okta group mapping
- Redwood to create astra-prod workspace with RBAC scaffold

Week 2 (validation & signoff) — deliverables:
- PoC test suite run by Astra devs (sample prompts & perf targets)
- Security questionnaire completed (we'll collect answers from your team)
- Procurement: DocuSign order form to finalize billing (if no blockers)

Assignees / notes:
- Redwood: Monica (CS) — overall PM; Ben — workspace provisioning and API seed; Karthik — SSO/SCIM and dev handoff
- AstraHead: Alex / Priya — admin confirmations; Security — SOC 2 review; Procurement — order form timing

Ben — can you confirm the expected lead time to seed the sandbox keys and create the projects once we have the admin list? I estimate 24 hours for sandbox, 2 business days for prod workspace with KMS integration.

Thanks — Monica

- Procurement needs the order form (line items + start date) by EOD Friday 9/5 to hit our internal quarterly cut-off.
